Hi Samira / team —

I reviewed the scope in the PDF. A few technical notes:
- 350k-token documents are large; we recommend chunking to ~64k windows with overlap for retrieval-augmented runs unless you need full-sequence attention for model evaluation. Full-sequence tests increase compute and TPM substantially.
- If you're running full-context evals on a 350k sequence, estimate ~0.9–1.2x token amplification depending on model variant (context handling + KV cache rehydrate). Your earlier observed peak TPM of ~420k aligns with full-context runs.

Ballpark allowance suggestion for a 30-day POC extension: +250k credit units (this should cover a mix of full-context evals and chunked runs). If Novaline wants to focus purely on full-context fidelity testing, consider +350k credits or a short dedicated pass on Redwood Dedicated (we can provision a reserved slot for a weekend run).

I've attached a very short runbook with model variant + quantization recommendations: prefer RLHF-validated open checkpoint in 8-bit for latency/quality tradeoff; avoid 4-bit for the first fidelity pass.

Attachments: (runbook excerpt embedded in novaline_poc_scope.pdf)

If that allowance sounds good I'll pass to Growth Ops for approval.
